title: Fall Ball Idle
desc: Fall Ball Idle is a physics idle game where sports balls, including golf balls, drop through colorful obstacle paths. Nudge the balls, earn coins, buy upgrades, and keep the flow moving.
howto: Click or tap near balls to nudge their path.
Guide balls through obstacles to earn coins.
Spend coins on upgrades and stronger traits.
Let idle income build while you improve the setup.
tips: Upgrade steady income before chasing expensive boosts.
Nudge only when a ball is about to miss a useful path.
Physics runs are uneven, so judge upgrades over several drops.
Keep reinvesting early coins to speed up later progress.
